mentions.name: Scrapboard
mentions.description: A Pinterest alternative built on the Bluesky ecosystem's ATProto protocol for collecting and sharing images. It focuses on high-quality content over volume, and the culture of adding alt text to images makes image search work well.
mentions.problem: Pinterest has been overtaken by AI content.
mentions.source_excerpt: Very much a hobby, but I'm working on a Pinterest alternative built on ATProto called Scrapboard[1]

mentions.name: Scrapboard
mentions.description: This app is a Pinterest-style image board that filters out AI-generated imagery. It is built on top of Bluesky, leveraging Bluesky's large library of well alt-texted images to aid search.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building a Pinterest clone that filters out AI generated imagery[1]. It is built on top of Bluesky so gets the benefit of its large library of well alt-text'd images, which aids with search.
